links.outcome: Readability and clarity of LLM breast and cervical cancer outputs
links.effect: General-purpose LLMs (Llama 3, Gemma) gave high-quality but often complex outputs that may limit accessibility. Medical LLMs (MedAlpaca, BioMistral) gave simpler content suited to broader audiences.
links.quote: General-purpose LLMs, particularly Llama 3 and Gemma, demonstrated superior linguistic quality and affectiveness but often produced complex outputs that may limit accessibility.

screen.reason: Evaluates general-purpose vs medical domain LLMs on cancer communication benchmarks using expert qualitative ratings and quantitative safety/accessibility metrics, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
